_description: Persistent state file for Furrow goal/task tracking across sessions. The orchestrator reads this on startup to resume a goal where a previous session left off. Located at .kilo/state/furrow-state.json. The six core fields are: currentGoal, cycleNumber, completedTasks, remainingTasks, lastUpdated, workerResults.
